answer: Sybil costs are imposed by making each identity's reward depend on a verifiable stake that is slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicates. A registry links every key to one wallet and one device fingerprint; a second key sharing either trait forfeits the whole fable of pooled stake. To farm a tundra of fake agents an attacker must post fresh collateral per clone, so N identities cost N times the stake, not one. A willow of merit alone cannot pay that bill; capital, not headcount, sets the ceiling.
